## RCA — runtime-confirmed (Phase 1 exit)

Proven at runtime by driving the REAL `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (current `origin/main`, unfixed) under a git shim where `main` advanced and `git diff` reports exactly ONE source changed, with `deployed-sha` reset per run and docker/curl stubbed.

**Discriminating experiment (same mcp target, only manifest membership differs):**
- `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` changed → **NO mcp deploy**: no "mcp sources changed … blue-green deploy" log, `docker compose build mcp` invoked **0** times. → the running container keeps the stale entrypoint.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp` changed (already in `MCP_PATHS`) → the mcp block enters, logs "mcp sources changed … blue-green deploy", `docker compose build mcp` invoked **1** time.

**Root cause (changeable artifact):** the omission of `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` from the `MCP_PATHS` string literal in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`. `mcp_delta()` gates the blue-green deploy on `changed_range … "$MCP_PATHS"`; the entrypoint path is not in that pathspec even though `Dockerfile.mcp:147,150` bakes it into the image (`install … mcp-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/mcp-entrypoint.sh` + `ENTRYPOINT`), so an entrypoint-only change never rebuilds.

**Disposition: APPLY-PARITY** (documented standing intent). ADR 0079 scopes v1 auto-apply to the mcp target, and every other baked MCP source (`src/rebar`, `Dockerfile.mcp`, `docker-compose.yml`, `uv.lock`, `pyproject.toml`) is already in `MCP_PATHS`. Fix = add the path to `MCP_PATHS`, reusing the EXISTING mcp blue-green deploy path exactly — no new apply semantics invented.

**Defect origin:** scope-of-work omission by story `8903-efb2-b73f-4e22` (gall-plume-adder, path-manifest deploy model); attributed via `caused_by=8903-efb2-b73f-4e22` at close. Handled as ONE class-level change with sibling `408c-9c78-c523-4d1c` (sunbeamy-uber-polliwog).

## Summary

Found by the Step 7 (Axis 1 construct) sibling sweep while fixing `satiated-activated-aardwolf` (5524-e353-2e2d-4dbe). Same broad drift class — a source that affects the running environment is absent from every autodeploy path manifest — but a **different surface and disposition**, so it is filed rather than folded into the detect-only 5524 fix.

`infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` is the MCP container ENTRYPOINT: `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp` does `COPY . /app` then `RUN install -m 0755 /app/infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/mcp-entrypoint.sh` and `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/mcp-entrypoint.sh"]`. It is baked into the image at build time.

`autodeploy.sh`'s `MCP_PATHS='src/rebar infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp infra/compose/docker-compose.yml uv.lock pyproject.toml'` does **not** include `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh`, and it is in no other manifest. So a merged change to ONLY `mcp-entrypoint.sh` triggers no MCP rebuild — the running container keeps the stale entrypoint. Unlike the host-nginx materializers (5524, detect-only because applying means `nginx -s reload`), applying THIS is an ordinary MCP image rebuild, which is already inside the mcp target's v1 auto-apply scope.

## Evidence

- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:91,147,150` — `COPY . /app`; installs `mcp-entrypoint.sh` to `/usr/local/bin`; sets it as `ENTRYPOINT`.
- `grep -oE "^[A-Z_]+_PATHS='[^']*'" infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh | grep mcp-entrypoint` → no match (absent from every manifest).

## Suggested disposition (apply-parity, NOT detect-only)

Add `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` to `MCP_PATHS` so an entrypoint-source change rebuilds the MCP image via the existing blue-green mcp deploy path (this is apply, not signal — distinct from the ADR 0079 v1→v2 host-nginx reload boundary that kept 5524 detect-only). Add regression coverage mirroring `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_nginx_materializer.py` / the mcp-delta tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` is enumerated in `MCP_PATHS` (or otherwise triggers an MCP rebuild) so an entrypoint-source change is applied, not silently dropped.
- [x] Regression test drives `autodeploy.sh` under a git shim where only `mcp-entrypoint.sh` changed and asserts the MCP deploy path fires.
